D11Digital

Tuner / Scope

A measuring tool for the rack

Shows signals as a waveform, tunes oscillators to the cent and measures control voltages. Two inputs with THRU jacks.

  • 1.3-inch OLED display
  • Can stay in line permanently
  • Tuner, oscilloscope and voltmeter
